newsitem.title: FINLAND: HELSINKI UP GINGERLY AHEAD OF ERICSSON H1.
newsitem.headline: HELSINKI UP GINGERLY AHEAD OF ERICSSON H1.

text.p: hesitant early trade ahead of a first-half earnings report from
Nokia's Swedish rival Ericsson due around 0900 GMT and
seen setting the tone for for much of Thursday, brokers said.
Nokia was little moved, then wobbled and later gained 1.00
markka to 426.00. "One markka up or down ahead of the Ericsson
result is meaningless," one broker said, adding that softness in
some other shares was mainly due to low activity.
Nokia often tracks Ericsson. The Swedish telecom is expected
to show a 21 percent H1 pre-tax profit gain to 5.11 billion
